key_insight: An all-valid-state HOBO encoding reuses otherwise invalid states to remove a penalty term, making VQE-based TSP optimization more reliable on NISQ devices.
engineering_relevance: The encoding improves practical scalability and solution feasibility for constrained combinatorial optimization on near-term quantum hardware.
method: Built an efficient binary HOBO Hamiltonian for the traveling salesperson problem.
Introduced AVS-HOBO via cyclic mapping to eliminate one penalty term and expand the valid state space.
Compared original HOBO vs. AVS-HOBO in noiseless simulation and on real quantum chips with error mitigation.
evidence_signal: The paper reports evaluations on TSP instances up to 20 cities, comparing convergence, approximation, tour-length, and feasibility ratios in simulation and hardware tests.
watch_item: Performance gains depend on device noise and error-mitigation quality, so results may vary across hardware architectures and larger instances.
paper_title: All-valid-state HOBO encoding for constrained combinatorial optimization on NISQ devices
